title: The Locked Room on the Rue Morgue
description: Paris, the 1840s. Neighbours heard two voices, one in a language none of them could name, and the door was locked from the inside.

rights.inspiration_title: The Murders in the Rue Morgue
rights.notes: Poe died in 1849; the story was first published in 1841 in Graham's Magazine. Public domain in India and the US. Source is The Works of Edgar Allan Poe, Volume 1.
